name: Game Event
description: Defines a world event (holiday, seasonal event, server-side event...): its scheduling type, occurrence/length, and grouping/linking to other events.

fields.name: Entry
fields.help: Event id 0 is reserved and cannot be used.

fields.name: Schedule Type
fields.help: GameEventScheduleType enum: 0 SERVERSIDE (start/end fully controlled by server, e.g. via .gameevent start/stop), 1 DATE (classic explicit start_time/end_time schedule from game_event_time), 2-4 Darkmoon Faire (weekly rotation), 5-10 Darkmoon Faire building stages, 11 YEARLY, 12 LUNAR_NEW_YEAR, 13 EASTER.

fields.name: Occurence
fields.help: How often (in minutes) the event repeats.

fields.name: Length
fields.help: How long (in minutes) the event stays active each occurrence. Must be > 0 and <= Occurence.

fields.name: Holiday
fields.help: Holidays.dbc id; when set, drives calendar/quest holiday checks and the holiday-specific schedule computation.

fields.name: Linked To
fields.help: If set, this event can only be active while the referenced event is also active.

fields.name: Event Group
fields.help: Arbitrary group id; all events sharing a non-zero group are tracked together (used to pick a random/rotating member of the group).

fields.name: Creatures
fields.help: Creature spawns added/removed by this event.

fields.name: Gameobjects
fields.help: Gameobject spawns added/removed by this event.

fields.name: Creature Data
fields.help: Creature model/equipment/spell changes during this event.

fields.name: Quests
fields.help: Quests only available during this event.

fields.name: Mails
fields.help: Mails sent when this event starts/stops.

fields.name: Schedule
fields.help: Explicit schedule entries of this event.
